result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Gusto is my top recommendation** if you want payroll, employee onboarding, benefits administration, and basic HR management in one place without needing a dedicated HR department.

However, the best choice depends on whether you primarily need payroll, employee management, compliance, recruiting, or a complete HR platform.

Here are the platforms I'd shortlist in 2026.

## Best HR software for small businesses

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Gusto**

(Best overall for most small businesses)

- Payroll and tax filing
- Employee onboarding and document storage
- Benefits administration
- PTO and employee self-service

Published starting price: approximately \$49/month + \$6/employee.

[Gusto website](https://gusto.com/)

---

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best dedicated HR platform)

- Employee records and HR documentation
- Onboarding and offboarding
- Performance reviews
- Employee satisfaction and reporting

Pricing varies; small-business minimums can start around \$250/month.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![Rippling Company Profile Funding & Investors | YourStory](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SAzMvIL6PtbUMLb8gBTabCeVnrSEXbTwCT-aC0SC4jJFQ74dXv0idEYA-gW8Xf4QyVq2JUnFjv2iQman7uk3D8kUDVp4a4whGwY7X8hxbhcNKKU6eqdr0HQC44Yinb10-d1Qx8pYpUGPKlk3izjNGAFETr0jiBpGuRO01GQ7GCiUG98Lat9yOYtjvREa50cA?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

(Best for automation and growth)

- HR, payroll, and benefits
- Automated onboarding
- Employee software and device management
- Advanced workflows and reporting

Starting pricing is advertised around \$8/employee plus a base fee; modules cost extra.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

- Employee information
- Leave and attendance tracking
- HR workflows
- Customizable employee management

Entry-level pricing starts around \$1.50/employee/month.

[Zoho People website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![RUN Powered by ADP® Payroll Software | ADP](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RpGcHs-PaNOo1cKIxFpsEQuw9zfE12TEYccICxkqqcA3CO2NvRfDtJbCfHi2Nr0YYYblVCChq2UL52-TzeRVq7RXCW745y0Vk8MEKZHTp113Xnj3kep_aCHaeYLzdBWH7veM5Y6_lQASKp9n8UaI6GWb3lo9RY4lH6rVom7VA1O8HweTnOpsYnwKG4YX01TL?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. ADP RUN**

(Best for payroll support)

- Payroll processing and tax administration
- HR and compliance resources
- Employee onboarding
- Additional HR support options

Custom pricing based on company size and services.

[ADP RUN website](https://www.adp.com/what-we-offer/products/run-powered-by-adp.aspx)

## Quick comparison

| Software | Best use | Budget |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Gusto | Payroll + HR | \$\$ |
| BambooHR | Full HR management | \$\$–\$\$\$ |
| Rippling | HR + IT automation | \$\$–\$\$\$ |
| Zoho People | Basic HR on a budget | \$ |
| ADP RUN | Payroll + compliance | \$\$–\$\$\$ |


These are relative cost categories, not direct price comparisons. Pricing and included features vary by plan. [technologyadvice.com](https://technologyadvice.com/blog/human-resources/best-hr-software-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/best-hris-for-small-businesses-in-2026-6-practical-picks/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[fitsmallbusiness.com](https://fitsmallbusiness.com/best-hris-hrms-software-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

- If you have 5–25 employees: Start with Gusto.
- If you have 25–100 employees: Look closely at BambooHR and Rippling.
- If you have a limited budget: Consider Zoho People.
- If you need more payroll and compliance support: Consider ADP RUN.
